info.name: DAVC LDAP Provisioning
info.summary: Provision multiple DAV Connector accounts from LDAP attributes
info.description:
Companion app for Nextcloud DAV Connector. Administrators can create multiple independent Basic-auth DAV profiles for calendars, contacts, and separate accounts. Each profile reads its login and app password from configurable LDAP attributes and creates or updates the user's DAV Connector service without modifying DAV Connector. Users opt in to each profile independently only when both attributes contain values.
The first release is intentionally conservative and supports Nextcloud 34 with DAV Connector 1.1.x only. Unknown DAV Connector versions fail closed.
info.author: Community prototype
